# Clean Clean Commercial Cleaning

> Family-owned commercial cleaning company with 5+ years of experience, providing office cleaning, commercial janitorial services, and customized cleaning plans for businesses in Bradenton, Sarasota, Lakewood Ranch, Palmetto, and surrounding areas of Florida (USA). Tagline: "Clean Space. Better Business."

Clean Clean serves offices, retail stores, medical and professional offices, and other commercial facilities. Every client gets a customized cleaning plan, with flexible scheduling that includes after-hours and weekend cleaning. The team is background-checked, trained, and fully insured, uses eco-friendly products, and offers a 100% satisfaction guarantee. Quotes are free and carry no obligation.
